description.zh: 用多项式拟合带噪声的点：训练误差随灵活度单调下降，测试误差先降后升；数据量、换批数据和岭回归如何改变它。数据与种子固定，是教学演示。
description.en: Fit noisy points with polynomials: training error falls monotonically with flexibility while test error falls then rises; how data size, resampling and ridge regression change this. Fixed data and seeds make it a teaching demonstration.

label.zh: 换批数据的散布就是方差

reason.zh: 高次多项式在不同训练批上拟合出差别很大的曲线，这种随样本而变的散布正是方差；偏差则是平均拟合偏离真实曲线的部分。
reason.en: A high-degree polynomial fitted to different training batches gives very different curves; that sample-to-sample scatter is the variance, while bias is how far the average fit sits from the true curve.

label.zh: 同样的模式出现在树上
label.en: the same pattern appears in trees

reason.zh: 决策树的深度和多项式的次数都是灵活度旋钮：灵活度越高，训练准确率越好，而新数据上的表现在有噪声时先升后降。
reason.en: Tree depth and polynomial degree are both flexibility knobs: higher flexibility improves training performance, while performance on new data rises then falls when there is noise.

title.zh: 为什么训练得越好，新数据反而更差？
title.en: Why can better training mean worse results on new data?
